value.rationale: The source introduces a natural output-entropy optimization distinction between invariant and arbitrary input laws but leaves a quantitative extremal gap. This exact family demonstrates that even identical fair one-symbol input margins cannot prevent stationarity from suppressing almost all output non-invariant entropy; the sharp global supremum is \(\log2\) nats and is never achieved by a fixed positive continuous Jacobian. The explicit unique periodic maximizing stationary input and every-\(q\) formula make the boundary reproducible and informative beyond the general reduction.
